facts.fact: POTRAZ warned it would work with police to raid and arrest people and businesses using, distributing or advertising Starlink equipment, saying some defaulters had already been arrested; Starlink has not been approved in Zimbabwe and use is prosecutable.
Starlink called Zimbabwe an unauthorised territory and said it would disable roaming service there until it obtains POTRAZ approval; it plans to launch in Q3 2024 per its coverage map.
